=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18404-18420 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The queue-backpressure hold lives inside `phase_cap_can_dispatch`, which callers reach only when `phase_cap_state_for_action` returns a non-empty state. That function returns "" for `retrigger_review`, `resolve_merge_conflict` and `dispatch_rb_judge`, so the `[ -n "${phase_cap_state}" ] &&` short-circuit skips the hold for those actions.
  WHY: When the Actions queue is at or above ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH, stall recovery still dispatches review runs (`_dispatch_review_for_conflicts`, 20890-20900 / 20991-21000) and conflict-resolver runs into the jammed queue, and logs no `QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE outcome=held` line. agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md:6 also says the hold "covers stall-recovery re-dispatch" without this qualification. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18505-18507 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The queue-backpressure hold returns 1 from `phase_cap_can_dispatch`, the same value a phase-cap block returns. Callers at 20451, 20600, 21636, 21765, 26472, 27125 and 27723 therefore log the hold under the contractual `reason=phase_capped` token (agents.md:4611-4612), and no `reason=queue_backpressure` token exists.
  WHY: With caps disabled or empty and the queue deep, the poller emits `STALL_SKIP ... reason=phase_capped` and `PERSIST governor outcome=deferred reason=phase_capped`, so operators and the log-analysis pipeline blame the phase-concurrency caps. Only the separate `QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE outcome=held` line records the real cause. All three reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 confirmed the call sites but deliberately did not re-raise it, as a pre-existing NIT about log wording.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:506-511 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run added `checks: read` to the `runner-image-canary` job's permissions and rewrote agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase1-runner-pin.md line 2. Neither path is in issue #9736's `files_touched` grant (the fragment is covered only by the `agents.d/*` glob).
  WHY: The edit is correct and needed, because ci.yml `final-ci-failed` (line 4923) requests `checks: read`. But a files_touched scope check will see a workflow-permission edit outside the grant, and the PR body never explains it as an inherited Phase 1 (PR 9452) fix. Rated NIT.
- .github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml:5 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The run-name branch is chosen by `startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[E2E ')`, and the issue author controls the title. For an "[E2E "-prefixed issue, display_title is the bare issue title (no `[issue:N]`) and head_branch is the default branch. The same expression appears at internal-plan.yml:5, internal-implement.yml:5 and workflow-templates/ai-{clarify,plan,implement}.yml:7. The parse that then fails is at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19008-19009.
  WHY: `build_active_issue_set` leaves the issue out of ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_ISSUES while its queued run is live, so stall recovery re-dispatches it. Any issue author can opt out of run linkage, although the exception exists only for the three smoke titles (test-and-mark-stable.yml:854, 5523, 5817). Rated NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28606-28608 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In STANDALONE_PR_SWEEP_ONLY mode, `prime_phase_concurrency_snapshot` is skipped. The other `_load_actions_runs_cached` calls run inside command substitutions (18923, 19054, 21052, 22630, 26721), and `build_active_issue_set` itself is invoked as `$(...)` (34256, 25709). So ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL never reaches the parent shell for `run_standalone_stall_recovery` (35647).
  WHY: The hold fails open (`QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE outcome=unknown queued=unknown high=150`, 18466-18474), so backpressure silently does not apply on those ticks. This is an operability gap rather than a crash, since fail-open is the documented contract. Rated NIT.
- changelog.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md:7 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog advertises ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH (default 150; `0`/`-1` turns the hold off) and QUEUED_RUN_ZOMBIE_MINUTES (line 6) as operator knobs. Nothing exports them into the poller: orchestrate_poll.yml never mentions them, and the script reads the value only from its own environment at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18451.
  WHY: An operator who sets the repo variable still gets the default 150. The only way to change it is to edit the poller script. Rated NIT.
- agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md:5 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL is empty (unknown) "on a memory-cache hit". In fact the in-process cache hit returns at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18213-18216, before the reset at 18217, so the value from the earlier fetch in the same tick is kept. Only the cross-process `ai_memory.py` cache hit (18255-18260) leaves it unknown.
  WHY: Operators reading the fragment would conclude the hold is inert after the first fetch of a tick, when it actually keeps enforcing the last known depth. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same wording issue only as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Audit the 31 `display_title` readers in `scripts/` (`grep -n display_title scripts/*.sh scripts/*.py`). For each, record whether it reads runs of the four workflows and whether adding ` [issue:N]` changes its match. Adjust only readers whose match would break, keeping their old behaviour (§6). List the audit in the PR body." (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:129, Phase 3 step 5; risk row at :188; the plan wins where it is more specific than the issue)
  expected_change_site: PR description (audit inventory with an outcome per reader), plus the reader inventory in agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description has only the pre-push gate and acceptance tables, with no reader audit. The agents.d fragment names only the three heal readers (its line 7), not the remaining ~28. The adjusted readers are present in the diff (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py `_issue_linked_run_matches` 1209, `issue_linked_runs` 1253, `select_failed_runs` 1691, `_trend_issue_linked_runs` 6704, `code_ref` 7806). scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:247 and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1379, 1551 and 1703 survive only because of the `[E2E ` run-name exception, and no artefact records this.
- requirement: "Stay inside files_touched." (linked issue #9736, Constraints)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml (`runner-image-canary` job permissions, lines 495-511), and, for the same reason, agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase1-runner-pin.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN DIFF adds `checks: read` at nightly-validation-selftest.yml:506-511 and rewrites the Phase-1 fragment's union list. The workflow path is not in the grant, which covers only internal-clarify.yml, internal-plan.yml, internal-implement.yml, the three ai-*.yml templates, the two scripts, the test file, `tests/**`, `changelog.d/*` and `agents.d/*`. The change itself is correct and required: ci.yml:4923 `final-ci-failed` requests `checks: read`, and tests/test_runner_image_pin_contract.py:207-225 requires the exact union. The scope was introduced by #9656 (agents.d/9656-final-ci-infra-rerun.md:5). scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py (check_automation_paths → path_not_granted) and scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:360-376 (verify_out_of_scope) both classify the path as out of scope. The PR body should declare it as an inherited Phase-1 fix, or the change should move to the owning issue.
- requirement: "Add `run-name:` to the four `internal-*.yml` wrappers and their `workflow-templates/` counterparts." (plan step 6 at docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:130; run-linkage section at :76; goal at :27, which includes clarify-respond)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/internal-orchestrate-clarify-respond.yml (after line 1) and workflow-templates/ai-orchestrate-clarify-respond.yml (after line 3), plus the agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md run-name registry and the WRAPPERS map in tests/test_poll_issue_run_linkage.py:48-55
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither wrapper has a `run-name:` key: internal-orchestrate-clarify-respond.yml:1-5 and ai-orchestrate-clarify-respond.yml:3-6 go straight from `name:` to `on: issue_comment`. Their default-branch runs therefore cannot match the `[issue:N]` parse at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19008-19009. The WRAPPERS map lists only the six touched wrappers, so no test catches the omission.
- requirement: "Touch no other lines in the templates."
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml, workflow-templates/ai-plan.yml, workflow-templates/ai-implement.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Each template adds explanatory comment lines in addition to the requested `run-name:` line.
- requirement: "The tests pass."
  expected_change_site: The listed acceptance tests, including tests/test_poll_issue_run_linkage.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push gate reports `container_rc_137` with zero tests or checks run, and the acceptance tests are still marked `not run`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
